name_cn: 立新集团纺织科研（江苏）有限公司
main_products: Nylon and polyester woven fabrics, breathable down-proof coated fabric, yarn-dyed fabric, T/C fabric, functional outdoor fabric
woven_evidence: Its product lines (nylon and polyester taslon, down-proof coated fabric, yarn-dyed and T/C fabric) are woven.

canton_fair.evidence_note: A JSTV news report on Shengze companies at the 136th Canton Fair says it showed breathable down-proof coated fabric, and 4 buyers from the US, Canada, Italy and Georgia placed orders on site.

notes: Its fabrics are mainly outdoor and jacket fabrics, which suit jackets and workwear rather than shirting. It also exhibits at Intertextile Shanghai.
